assertions.description: The ::interest-button pseudo-element selector is recognised by the CSS parser (necessary but NOT sufficient: Chrome parses it even when no box renders).
A non-disabled <button interestfor> whose target exists generates an ::interest-button box when content is not none: a following inline marker moves by the pseudo's 37px width.
An <a href interestfor> is a valid interest source and generates an ::interest-button box when content is not none.
assertions.test:
(()=>{const st=document.createElement('style');document.head.appendChild(st);const w=document.createElement('div');w.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:0;top:0;white-space:nowrap;visibility:hidden';w.innerHTML='a|
';document.body.appendChild(w);const h=w.firstElementChild,m=w.querySelector('.cf-mk');const x0=m.getBoundingClientRect().left;st.textContent='.cf-h::interest-button{content:"x";display:inline-block;inline-size:37px;margin:0;padding:0;border:0}';const x1=m.getBoundingClientRect().left;w.remove();st.remove();return Math.round(x1-x0);})()>=30

assertions.description: The UA stylesheet sets no content on ::interest-button, so an interest source without an author content value generates no box (opt-in).
A disabled <button interestfor> is not a valid interest source, so no ::interest-button box is generated even with content set.
assertions.test:
(()=>{const st=document.createElement('style');document.head.appendChild(st);const w=document.createElement('div');w.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:0;top:0;white-space:nowrap;visibility:hidden';w.innerHTML='|
';document.body.appendChild(w);const h=w.firstElementChild,m=w.querySelector('.cf-mk');const x0=m.getBoundingClientRect().left;st.textContent='.cf-h::interest-button{content:"x";display:inline-block;inline-size:37px;margin:0;padding:0;border:0}';const x1=m.getBoundingClientRect().left;w.remove();st.remove();return Math.round(x1-x0);})()===0

assertions.description: An <a interestfor> without href is not a valid interest source, so no ::interest-button box is generated.
A <span interestfor> is not a valid interest source, so no ::interest-button box is generated.
Removing the interestfor attribute after layout removes the ::interest-button box (WPT interestfor-pseudo-element-dynamic).
A generated ::interest-button box exists and hit-testing a point over it (beyond where the originating element ends) returns the originating element (WPT interestfor-pseudo-element-block-button).
assertions.test:
